contributions.detail: 8 itemized rows sum to exactly 1375.00, which equals BOTH cover line 1 THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE (LAST REPORT reads N/A, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide). The Carr form prints NO schedule total (sheet ends with the 'If additional space is needed' note), so schedule_total is null; the filer HAND-WROTE his own totals on Form A ('Total cash donation $1125.00', 'Total in kind donation $400.00', 'GRAND TOTAL $1525.00') and those are filer annotations, not printed fields. They cross-check: 1375 itemized + 150 aggregate = 1525 grand total; in-kind 200+200 = 400; cash 1525-400 = 1125. The 'aggregate donations less than $50 (25,10,25,25,30,35) $150.00' line written in the ledger is the cover line-2 sub-$50 aggregate and is NOT an itemized contribution — it is deliberately NOT emitted as a row (per core brief section 4 sub-$50 trap); had it been included the side would falsely have failed the line-1 gate.

expenditures.basis: cover-line3-cumulative (and the filer's own hand-written 'Total spent 1,042.80' on Form B)
expenditures.detail: 13 itemized rows sum to 1043.40; the filer's own hand-written 'Total spent' on Form B reads 1,042.80 and cover line 3 reads 1,042 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (no cents written on the cover). Residual delta 0.60 against the filer's Form B total, 1.40 against the cover's whole-dollar figure. This is FILER ARITHMETIC and the SAME 0.60 recurs, unchanged, in this filer's later final report (key a50582f4, whose 15 rows sum 1323.40 against a printed 'Total spent 1,322.80') -- an independent confirmation that the shortfall is carried in the filer's own total, not in the transcription. Every amount was re-read in tight 600-1200 dpi crops on BOTH scans of this sheet and each is unambiguous. No single-cell re-read closes the total: the only values that would are 157.00 on row 8 (Sams Club) or 279.75 on row 13, and 1200 dpi crops of row 8 on both scans show an unmistakable superscript 6 (157.60) while row 13's third digit is an unmistakable 0. Both figures retained verbatim; no row adjusted. needs_review=1 on every row of this side.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr 5-5-PG form prints NO schedule total and NO page subtotal on either Form A or Form B (both sheets end with '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper...)'). The cover's own three-column block is therefore the ONLY anchor. Form A gate: p3 rows 1375.00 = cover line 1 THIS = CUM 1375.00, EXACT. Form B gate: p4 rows 1043.40 vs the filer's hand-written 'Total spent 1,042.80' and cover line 3 '1,042' -- WOULD NOT GATE, delta 0.60 (see recon.expenditures).
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 returns geometry_status ok but only 26 h-rules, ALL in the empty lower half (10.36 = header underline, then nothing until 34.60): the tool loses the printed rules exactly where the filer's heavy pencil crosses them, so it UNDERCOUNTS the inked region and is not usable as the row count here. Counted by ink instead: p3 carries 8 itemized rows + 1 sub-$50 aggregate line + 3 filer total lines + 1 in-kind legend line -- 8 rows emitted. p4 rowbands likewise returns rules only from 25.41 down; counted by ink: 13 inked ledger rows + 1 re-written amount on the line below row 13 + 1 'Total spent' line -- 13 rows emitted. Measured pitch from the detected rules is 2.30-2.32 pct of page height on both sheets, consistent with the ink spacing.

gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 prints +83.00 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. On a CASH basis it closes to the dollar: cash receipts 1125 (975 itemized cash + 150 sub-$50 aggregate; the 400 of in-kind is excluded) minus expenses 1042 (the cover's whole-dollar figure) = 83. It does NOT close on total receipts (1525 - 1042 = 483), and against the filer's own cents-bearing total (1125 - 1042.80 = 82.20) it is 0.80 out -- the filer rounded. Beginning balance is not printed (LAST REPORT column reads N/A on lines 1-2 and is blank on lines 3-4), so there is no prior-filing chain to test; this is the filer's only report in the chunk for this cycle (key a50582f4 is the same candidate's LATER 2018-11-28 report -- the cross-filing chain is reported there).

escalation_note: p3 amount column re-read in two 500 dpi bands (rows 1-4, rows 5-8) plus three 600 dpi single-cell proof crops. p4 amount column re-read in two 600 dpi bands (rows 1-7, rows 7-13), then row 8 (Sams Club cents) at 1200 dpi and row 13's re-written amount at 900 and 1200 dpi, plus a 600 dpi crop of the struck row-4 cell. It was settled instead by key a50582f4, this filer's later final report, whose Form B is THE SAME PHYSICAL SHEET photocopied again after two more rows were added, and which was scanned in COLOUR: there the figure is plainly blue ballpoint reading '280.35', with an open-left 3 and a flat-topped 5, at 900 dpi.
